title: The Confession of Bellwether Lane
author: Zephyrine Sterling
blurb: Emrys Villalobos, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
